# Facebook Pixel Guide

## What is Facebook Pixel?

Facebook Pixel is a tracking tool that measures user actions on your website after they interact with your Meta Ads.

## Benefits

- Track conversions
- Build remarketing audiences
- Optimize campaigns
- Improve ROAS

## Events

- Page View
- View Content
- Add To Cart
- Initiate Checkout
- Purchase
- Lead

## Best Practices

- Verify Pixel installation
- Test events before launch
- Connect with Meta Events Manager
